base_record_snapshot.lesson: A hand-carried streak counter whose declared UNIT does not match its counting PRACTICE converts unobserved intervals into asserted continuity. The review-close 'genuine-zero' streak is reported with an explicitly declared unit — 'unit: PASSES', inscribed as a ray at tic 704 — and was carried into tic 706 as '24 consecutive PASSES (680->706)'. The log does not support that reading under any single unit: audit-logs/services/review-close-check-log.jsonl holds 32 consecutive genuine-zero ROWS over that span (7 tics carry 2-3 rows each, from same-tic re-observations that the script itself marks decision=replace and files a superseded receipt for), across 24 DISTINCT check-bearing tics, inside a 27-tic span (680..706) in which 3 tics — 683, 687, 693 — had NO check row at all. The reported 24 therefore counts distinct check-bearing tics, not passes; and the three unobserved tics are silently absorbed into a claim of continuity. Two defects, one root: (a) the declared unit is not the counted unit, so the same number is defensible under whichever reading a given tic needs — the streak cannot be falsified by a miss; (b) 'consecutive' over a gapped observation series asserts the passing property for tics never measured, which is the presence/observation family's absence-conflation running in the favorable direction (an unobserved tic is not a passed tic). The cure is mechanization plus disclosure: the streak must be computed by the script that writes the log row (no hand-carried number in mandate/commit prose), must state its unit and compute in exactly that unit, and must disclose gaps and same-tic re-observations rather than absorbing them — a re-observation of an already-passing tic is not new evidence about a new boundary.
base_record_snapshot.note: DERIVABILITY CHALLENGE DISCLOSED, /review owns the altitude call: this sits adjacent to the presence-observation-fallacy-guard family (guard 4, observed-absence-does-not-prove-breakage-without-manifest-status) and may adjudicate as a refinement ray onto it rather than standalone — the net-new candidate is the favorable-direction mirror (an unobserved interval read as a passing interval) plus the declared-unit-vs-counted-unit mismatch, neither of which the existing guards name. No streak-computing code exists (grep found none) — the number lives only in mandate watch text and commit prose, which is itself part of the finding.
